text:
Alex Chen: Ok team — Greenfield Health RFP: they want a 4-week POC, SOC2 + HIPAA answers, and capability matrix aligned to their product features. I uploaded draft: https://dropbox.com/s/xyz/capability_matrix_v3.xlsx. POC scope: ingest EHR CSVs, low-latency QA, role-based access. Proposed timeline:

Week 0: setup env (VPC), Week 1: data ingest + model tuning, Week 2: integrations, Week 3: load test + handoff

Pricing: propose 3-month pilot at $7k/mo reserved capacity + $0.12 per 1k tokens overage. Thoughts?

Sara Patel: Looks good. For HIPAA we need BAAs — legal asked for MSA redline. I'll ping legal. Also recommend we include Dedicated option pricing with burst capacity.

Mahesh Iyer: For POC infra, recommend gpus: A40x4 will give stable perf. For low-latency SLO, set batch target 50ms.

Claire Gómez: Adding a short capability note: embed-based search latency and reranking are in the matrix. I flagged feature gaps: "token-level cost breakdown" and "customer-managed KMS" — both must be visible to customer.

Priya Singh: Security questionnaire — I answered sections 1-4 and attached redacted_SQ_answers.pdf. You'll see network diagram and encryption details there.

Alex Chen: @Sara please confirm legal contact. @Priya can you paste the specific SOC2 controls we meet? Need to show them in RFI.

Priya Singh: SOC2: CC7 (confidentiality), CC6 (change mgmt), CC3 (access). We have SOC2 Type II report; can share under NDA. Also HSM/KMS details in doc.

Sara Patel: Legal lead is Monica Rivera — I'll loop her in: @Monica Rivera are you available to review MSA redline this week? :pray:

sales-bot: Reminder: upload completed for capability_matrix_v3.xlsx to drive. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/greenfield/capability_matrix_v3.xlsx

Mahesh Iyer: Quick config snippet for the POC runtime:
```
model: redwood-1b-quant
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  target_latency_ms: 50
cache:
  prefix: true
  kv_cache: true
```

Claire Gómez: Also propose we include a small eval set (50 prompts) for regression monitoring. Customer will run acceptance tests — add acceptance criteria to SOW.

Alex Chen: Great. Next steps: Sara loop legal, Priya finalize SQ answers, Mahesh finalize infra estimate, Claire update matrix and SOW. I'll prepare the price worksheet and send to Greenfield today. :thumbsup:

Sara Patel: On it — will update thread when Monica is in.

Priya Singh: Uploaded redacted_SQ_answers.pdf to drive (link in doc). Done.

Alex Chen: Last ask — can someone confirm if Dedicated reserved price can drop to $6k/mo with 6-month commit? I want an option.

Mahesh Iyer: I can run numbers, but likely yes if committed. Will confirm by EOD.

Claire Gómez: Updated matrix with labeled gaps and mitigation notes.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Tagging this thread as prep for RFP response. End.
